answer: Give every identity an inviter, and slash the inviter's stake for each sybil descendant so liability climbs the invitation tree like a falcon tracing prey back to its roost. New agents must also spend non-transferable ivory credentials, earned only by completing real work audited against their record at the zenith of their reputation history. An attacker can mint thousands of fake identities, but each one costs stake plus verified labor, and every fake tree collapses when one member is caught, draining its sponsor dry.
